caption: The image depicts a drawing of a mechanical object composed primarily of metal, featuring a cylindrical vertical tube set atop a round, layered base. The tube has a metallic brass or bronze-like appearance, with a prominent spiral groove or track running diagonally upwards from the lower left to the upper right. Several small ball bearings or marbles are positioned along this groove. About halfway up the tube, extending horizontally to the left, is a straight rod or lever, also metallic in color. The base upon which the tube stands is circular, with two main tiers, and exhibits a golden-brown hue, giving it the appearance of polished brass or bronze. The background of the drawing is a plain light beige color, with no other objects present. The name "John Hall" appears lightly inscribed in the lower right corner.
